description: Boundary responses: same-step (trigger event itself carries ack=true, after=0 within=1), first-window-step (after=1 fulfilled immediately), and a trigger whose deadline falls on the final observed step with no response -> genuine deadline miss (distinct from premature close).

events.note: t0: same_step window [0,0] fulfilled on the trigger event itself
t3: fulfilled at first window step
t5: never_answered window [5,5]; rz absent => deadline missed at t5
